words.meaning: 资源记录签名（Resource Record Signature）
words.example: Each RRSIG (Resource Record Signature) covers one set of host records.
words.exampleZh: 每条 RRSIG（资源记录签名）覆盖一组主机记录。

words.example: The DS record in the parent zone links to our hospital signing key.
words.exampleZh: 父区域里的委托签名记录指向本院的签名密钥。

words.example: A glue record supplies the address of the name server itself.
words.exampleZh: 粘合记录提供的是域名服务器自身的地址。

words.example: Root hints tell our DNS server where the internet root servers are.
words.exampleZh: 根提示告诉 DNS 服务器，互联网根服务器在哪里。

words.example: The forwarder sends unknown names to the city's DNS service.
words.exampleZh: 转发器会把解析不了的名字交给市里的 DNS。
